newsitem.title: USA: AEP Mich. nuke boosts power after outage.
newsitem.headline: AEP Mich. nuke boosts power after outage.

text.p: American Electric Power Co Inc's 1,020 megawatt Cook nuclear power unit 1 increased power output to 87 percent of capacity Sunday from an unexpected maintenance outage which began Sept 22, a company spokesman said.
The Bridgeman, Mich., unit will continue to operate at the 87 percent level until a transformer is replaced during a maintenance outage scheduled for February 1997, spokesman Bill Schalk said Monday.
The unit was shut unexpectedly Sept 22 for repairs.

"Before the (unexpected Sept 22) trip we were running at 87 or 88 percent power due to a slightly underrated transformer," he said. "A new transformer is being built and is scheduled to be installed as a replacement in February 1997."
The plant is scheduled to be removed from service February 28 for 45 days.
The Cook 1 unit is operated by Indiana Michigan Power Co, a subsidiary of American Electric Power.
